title: Two Big Boxes
lines: She tosses in dishes and socks.
A fox naps in the last box!
Lin shuts the lid and does not see him.
Lin lifts the box. It tips. The fox dashes!
"What does a fox want with dishes?" she said.
Lin fixes the box and packs it.
Then she checks the two boxes.

questions.ask: What does Lin put in the boxes?
questions.listenFor: Dishes and socks. Both are in the same line.

questions.ask: Why does Lin check the boxes at the end?
questions.listenFor: So no fox is hiding in one this time. Let them say it in their own words.

questions.ask: What do you think the fox was doing in the box? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. The story says he was napping, so "it was a soft bed" fits well.
